reading.rtitle: Email from Emma -- Meeting with Mr. Becker on Tuesday
paras: Hi Carlos, next Tuesday at ten we have a video meeting with Mr. Becker, a coffee buyer from Germany. He wants to know about our work in Brazil. I know you are busy with the EUDR project, but please prepare five short parts.
First, introduce yourself: who you are and what you do every week. Second, say what you are working on right now. Third, say what our team can provide and what we can't provide this month.

Fourth, tell him about your last farm visit: where you went and what you found. Fifth, say your plan for next month. After that, Mr. Becker is going to ask some questions. Please answer slowly and clearly. You don't need to speak fluently. Thank you, Emma.
reading.source: Emma, Sustainability Coordinator, Sucafina Geneva -- internal email, A1 reading

listenings.text: Six months ago, I didn't write emails in English. I always used a translator. Now I can read a sustainability report, and I can write a short email to Emma. Every week I study with my teacher, and right now I am preparing for my first meeting with a buyer. Last month I visited three farms, and I wrote all the reports in English. It was not easy, but I did it. Next month I am going to present the Brazil results to the team in Geneva. My goal is simple: to speak slowly, clearly and with confidence.

Hi Carlos, it's Emma. Some news about Tuesday. Mr. Becker can't join at ten, so the meeting is at eleven now. He is traveling in Colombia this week, and he is visiting coffee farms there. He sent me two questions about Brazil. How many farms are in our EUDR project? And when did you visit them? Please bring the numbers to the meeting. And don't worry, he speaks slowly. See you on Tuesday.

extra_audio.text: First, who I am: I am a sustainability analyst at Sucafina. Then, the work now: right now I am preparing the EUDR maps. Next, yes and no: we can provide the maps, but we can't provide the training records. After that, the last visit: last month I visited three farms. Finally, the plan: next month I am going to visit three new farms.
